text: Any conclusion that hedge funds contributed to the financial crisis of 2007-2008 is circumstantial or anecdotal, because the data needed to test it, on leverage, counterparty relations, AUM, and portfolio holdings, were not collected for any substantial period before the crisis.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: Without such data for a substantial time period before the financial crisis, concluding that hedge funds may have had a role in the financial crisis is circumstantial or anecdotal.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to retrospective assessment of the 2007-2008 crisis
SEC systemic risk data collection began only after Title IV of the Dodd-Frank Act
